messages:
morgan: Hey devex, hitting weird client-side rate jitter in the sample-app during onboarding load tests — burst ~10 qps then drops to 1-2 qps for ~10s, paginator re-fetches and duplicates pages. Anyone seen this with JS SDK backoff + STS token refresh? @sam
sam: Hmm, can you share logs? Is token refresh happening at the same time as the drop? Might be auth handshake + circuit backoff. Also which SDK version?
alejandra: We ran into something similar last quarter. JS default backoff resets windows on non-429s which can cause pump-and-dump. Config snippet:
```
client: {
  concurrency: 4,
  prefetch: true,
  backoff: { baseMs: 100, maxMs: 5000, resetOnSuccess: false }
}
```
Try setting prefetch:false and concurrency:2.
ben: Repro steps that helped me:
1) run sampleapp with --burst=8 --duration=30
2) watch `/metrics` for inflight tokens
3) if you see inflight drop to 0 for >5s, that's the jitter.
Workaround: make SDK keep a min-inflight guard (we added minInflight=2).
irene: Noticed parity issue: Go SDK keeps cursor sticky (won't re-request after partial page) while JS replays the cursor when concurrency resets. There's an open PR: #5821 that aligns behaviors (staging). @morgan try the staging client build?
ci-bot: deploy started for package/devex-sampleapp@staging
morgan: Attaching small trace (trimmed):
```
[2024-11-12T15:02:11Z] request id=abc inflight=4 -> 0
[2024-11-12T15:02:12Z] auth refresh start
[2024-11-12T15:02:13Z] backoff triggered 429 -> wait 300ms
[2024-11-12T15:02:15Z] inflight=2 resumed
```
Looks like auth refresh + backoff window collapse. Will try staging build & flag changes. Thanks :pray:
sam: If you still see it after staging, file a tiny reproducer and assign to devex-oncall.
morgan: Will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
